name: Detail Cages Track (Web)

endpoints.description: Ambil 1 record Cages Track lengkap beserta grid Cages Tipped Time, station_name, dan nama user (Inputted By/Checked By/Acknowledged By)

business_logic: 1. Validate id ada di cages-track-record -> 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND jika tidak ditemukan

2. SELECT cages-track-record by id, JOIN station untuk station_name, JOIN user untuk created_by_name/checked_by_name/acknowledged_by_name (null jika belum diisi, kecuali created_by_name yang selalu ada)
3. SELECT semua cages-tipped-time by cages_track_record_id, ordered by tipped_hour, langsung dari kolom tersimpan tanpa hitung ulang
5. FE render field per section (Identitas, Data Sesi, Grid Cages Tipped Time, Verifikasi) read-only
6. On klik Back: navigasi client-side ke /data/cages-track, tanpa panggilan API tambahan

data_operations.description: SELECT semua baris by cages_track_record_id, ordered by tipped_hour

edge_case_handling.handling: Return 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND, FE tampilkan pesan error + tombol Back

business_rules_applied: Checked By dan Acknowledged By keduanya ditampilkan
Grid Cages Tipped Time ditampilkan langsung dari data tersimpan

unit_test_cases.description: returns 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND when id does not exist
returns full record with resolved station_name when id exists
returns tipped_times array ordered by tipped_hour
unit_test_cases.given: record dengan 3 cages-tipped-time rows, tipped_hour tidak berurutan saat disimpan

unit_test_cases.description: returns null checked_by_name and acknowledged_by_name when not set
unit_test_cases.given: record dengan checked_by dan acknowledged_by null

unit_test_cases.description: resolves created_by_name, checked_by_name, acknowledged_by_name to user names when present
unit_test_cases.given: record dengan created_by/checked_by/acknowledged_by terisi uuid user valid
unit_test_cases.expect: response berisi nama user yang sesuai untuk ketiganya, bukan uuid

screen_dependencies.reason: Entry point - klik baris membuka detail ini
Koreksi data dilakukan lewat form ini, bukan dari layar detail

implementation_notes: Response resolve created_by/checked_by/acknowledged_by ke nama user via join, mengikuti pola screen-019/020 persis
404 ditangani otomatis oleh ModelNotFoundException -> ApiExceptionHandler (findOrFail), sama seperti screen-019/020

Field grouping & urutan field di blade view MENIRU PERSIS mobile/src/views/DataPreviewCagesTrackView.vue mode detail (Cages Track Number, Tanggal, Tippler Start/Stop Time, Cages Out, Cages Tipped, Inputted By, Checked By, Acknowledged By, Note, grid Cages Tipped Time) per arahan eksplisit: web station screens mengikuti flow/UX mobile
Route /cages-track-records/{id} didaftarkan SETELAH /cages-track-records/export di routes/api.php agar segmen literal 'export' tidak ketangkap sebagai {id}
Route /data/cages-track/{id} mengaktifkan affordance clickable-row yang sudah dibangun di screen-018's Blade view
